rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a set of tasks or an assignment.

example.english: This is the mission my boss assigned me, and I have to finish it today.
example.traditional: 呢個係老闆交畀我嘅任務，我今日要做完。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 lou5 baan2 gaau1 bei2 ngo5 ge3 jam6 mou6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zou6 jyun4

rows.note: Use this for the concrete goal or objective being pursued.

example.english: Our mission now is to make it into the finals this season.
example.traditional: 我哋而家嘅目標係今季打入決賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 gam1 gwai3 daa2 jap6 kyut3 coi3

rows.note: Use this for a significant duty or life purpose, rather than an ordinary assignment or short-term goal.

example.english: Helping people in need is our mission.
example.traditional: 幫助有需要嘅人係我哋嘅使命。
example.jyutping: bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 si2 ming6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a trip undertaken for missionary or evangelizing work.

example.english: They went to Nepal on a mission trip.
example.traditional: 佢哋去尼泊爾參加宣教之旅。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 nei4 baak3 ji5 caam1 gaa1 syun1 gaau3 zi1 leoi5
